mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, category_name, icon_url, sort_order, status, show_on_home, remark, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_shop_category WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 1 AND (show_on_home IS NULL OR show_on_home = 1) ORDER BY sort_order DESC, id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dms_shop_category WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_shop_category (tenant_id, category_name, icon_url, sort_order, status, show_on_home, remark) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{categoryName}, #{iconUrl}, #{sort}, #{status}, COALESCE(#{showOnHome}, 1), #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_shop_category SET tenant_id = #{tenantId}, category_name = #{categoryName}, icon_url = #{iconUrl}, sort_order = #{sort}, status = #{status}, show_on_home = COALESCE(#{showOnHome}, 1), remark = #{remark}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
